info.title: MultiLocale API
info.description: Version 1 uses the /api/v1 path prefix. Breaking changes receive a new major prefix; additive changes remain in v1. The unversioned /api prefix remains a compatibility alias. The deprecation policy documents how Deprecation and Sunset response headers announce an endpoint lifecycle.

get.description: Lists the phrases of your organization. A phrase is one `{key, value, language}` triple belonging to one or more projects. Filter with `project`, `key` and `language`. Requires the `phrases:read` scope. A key scoped to a project only ever sees that project's phrases. For stable traversal, set `pagination=cursor`; the response becomes `{items, nextCursor}` and is ordered by `_id`. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null. Existing array responses and offset pagination remain available when cursor pagination is not requested.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated projection of fields to return

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: Set to `cursor` for a stable page envelope

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `nextCursor` from the preceding cursor page

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional bounded page size (maximum 2001; defaults to 100 in cursor mode)

200.description: Array of phrases, or `{items, nextCursor}` in cursor mode

post.summary: Start a demonstration asynchronous translation job
post.description: Demonstrates the API's asynchronous-job pattern without authentication. The response is `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header pointing at the job resource and a body carrying the job `_id` and `status`. Poll the `Location` URL until the status is `succeeded`, then read the translations from the job body. The job is deterministic fixture work that completes about two seconds after creation.

202.description: Job accepted; poll the `Location` URL for the result.
